channel.title: The Express Tribune
channel.description: Latest news from Pakistan and around the world

item.title: National Security Committee meets amid spike in Balochistan violence | The Express Tribune
item.description: Top civil and military leadership gathered in Islamabad on Friday to discuss a rise in militant attacks across Balochistan province.

item.title: Election Commission unveils by-poll schedule for two provinces | The Express Tribune
item.description: The ECP released dates for upcoming by-elections in Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, with polling set for next month.

item.title: Pakistan seal T20 series against Sri Lanka with dominant win
item.description: Pakistan clinched the T20 series 3-1 after a comfortable eight-wicket victory over Sri Lanka in Lahore on Thursday night.

item.title: Security forces kill four militants in North Waziristan operation | The Express Tribune
item.description: The military said troops conducted an intelligence-based operation in North Waziristan, killing four militants in an exchange of fire.

item.title: Bilawal Bhutto criticises federal government's flood response in Sindh
item.description: PPP chief Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari said the centre's disaster response in flood-hit Sindh districts has been too slow and demanded more funds.

item.title: Heavy monsoon rains forecast for Karachi over the weekend | The Express Tribune
item.description: The Met Office warned of heavy rainfall in Karachi and other parts of Sindh starting Saturday, urging residents to stay alert.

item.title: PSX gains momentum as investors eye IMF tranche news
item.description: Stocks rose at the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Friday as investors grew optimistic about the upcoming IMF loan disbursement.
